My name is Veerawat (Raymond) Udomvorakulchai. I am currently a Chemical Engineering PhD student at University College London (UCL). My research interest is in process systems engineering (PSE), focusing on developing tools to optimize real-world complex processes. 

Some publications on multi-agent systems for hybrid optimization under the supervision of Prof. Eric S. Fraga can be found below:

## Publications

::: {.publication-list}
1. <span class="publication-type">BOOK CHAPTER</span>

   [A multi-agent system for hybrid optimization](https://doi.org/10.1016/B978-0-443-28824-1.50556-1)

   <i class="bi bi-person-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i> Eric S. Fraga, Veerawat Udomvorakulchai, Lazaros G. Papageorgiou

   Part of the volume: 34th European Symposium on Computer Aided Process Engineering / 15th International Symposium on Process Systems Engineering.

2. <span class="publication-type">JOURNAL ARTICLE</span>

   Part of the special issue: Selected papers on Process systems engineering: methodology & applications from ESCAPE 34 - PSE 2024.

3. <span class="publication-type">CONFERENCE PAPER</span>
